[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Janczyk''' was the captain of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Dred Imperative]]'', which ferried refugees off the planet [[Demophon]] prior to its destruction via [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="I" />
